t1335.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records al-Husayn ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Walīd al-Juʿfī al-Kūfī, the reciter, as trustworthy and devout, of the ninth generation, who died in the year 203 or 204, aged eighty-four or eighty-five.
as: Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما رأيت أفضل من حسين الجعفي، وسعيد بن عامر.
I saw no one more virtuous than Ḥusayn al-Juʿfī and Saʿīd ibn ʿĀmir.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
محمد بن عبد الرحمن الهروي, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما رأيت أتقن من حسين الجعفي
I saw no one more precise than Ḥusayn al-Juʿfī.
Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah, quoted by al-Mizzī
The most virtuous man there could be has arrived.
يحيى بن يحيى النيسابوري, quoted by al-Mizzī
إن بقي أحد من الأبدال فحسين الجعفي.
If any of the abdāl remain, Ḥusayn al-Juʿfī is one of them.
أبو مسعود الرازي, quoted by al-Mizzī
He named al-Ḥafarī, Ḥusayn al-Juʿfī and others as the most virtuous men he had seen.
محمد بن رافع, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was the ascetic of Kūfah.
الحجاج بن حمزة, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما جالسته ضاحكا ولا متبسما قط، ولا سمعت منه كلمة ركن فيها إلى الدنيا كان يقرىء يوم الجمعة ولا يحول وجهه عن المحراب.
I never sat with him while he laughed or smiled. I heard no word from him showing worldly attachment. On Fridays he taught recitation without turning his face away from the prayer niche.
من أقرأ الناس؟ قلت: حسين بن علي الجعفي.
Asked who was the foremost reciter, I answered: Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī al-Juʿfī.
ثقة، وكان يقرئ القرآن رأس فيه، وكان رجلا صالحا لم أر رجلا قط أفضل منه.
Reliable, a leading teacher of Qurʾan recitation and an upright man. I never saw anyone more virtuous.
This is the ascetic of Juʿfī.
Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah, quoted by al-Mizzī
عجبت لمن مر بالكوفة فلم يقبل بين عيني حسين الجعفي
I am surprised by anyone who passes through Kufa without kissing Ḥusayn al-Juʿfī between the eyes.

t5443.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Fulayḥ ibn Sulaymān al-Khuzāʿī, Abū Yaḥyā al-Madanī, as truthful but making many errors, of the seventh generation, dying in 168 AH; it is said Fulayḥ is a nickname and his name is ʿAbd al-Malik.
as: Truthful, but he made many errors.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ضعيف، ما أقربه من أبي أويس.
Weak, very close to Abū Uways in standing.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ليس بقوي، ولا يحتج بحديثه، وهو دون الدراوردي. والدراوردي أثبت منه
He is not strong and his reports are not used as proof. He ranks below al-Darāwardī, who is more precise.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كانوا يرون أنه يتناول رجال الزهري.
They thought he spoke against al-Zuhrī’s transmitters.
وهذا خطأ عسى يتناول رجال مالك.
This is mistaken. He may have spoken against Mālik’s transmitters.
He agreed with Ibn Maʿīn that Fulayḥ’s reports should not be used as proof.
أحاديث مستقيمة، وغرائب، وقد اعتمده البخاري في صحاحه، وروى عنه الكثير، وقد روى عنه زيد بن أبي أنيسة، وهو عندي لا بأس به.

He related sound reports as well as unusual ones. Al-Bukhārī relied on him in his Ṣaḥīḥ and transmitted much from him, and Zayd ibn Abī Unaysah transmitted from him. In my judgment there is no objection to him.
يحيى ابن سعيد, quoted by al-Mizzī
أنه كان يقشعر من أحاديث فليح
Abū ʿUbayd asks about a report that Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd recoiled at Fulayḥ’s hadiths. Abū Dāwūd says it reached him from Ibn Maʿīn.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Ibn Maʿīn included Fulayḥ among those whose reports are not used as proof.
